# Deogenes Gregorio S. Maranan

Deogenes Gregorio S. Maranan is a Computer Science graduate from the Philippines with interests in cybersecurity, software engineering, artificial intelligence, and full-stack development.

## About

Deogenes Gregorio S. Maranan graduated Cum Laude with a Bachelor of Science in Computer Science from Batangas State University – The National Engineering University. He graduated with a GWA of 1.4643 (3.57/4.00) and was a DOST JLSS Scholar under RA 7687.

His technical interests include software engineering, cybersecurity, digital forensics, artificial intelligence, full-stack development, and competitive programming. He enjoys solving technical problems through software development, security research, and AI-driven applications.

## Cybersecurity

Deogenes has experience in cybersecurity, Capture the Flag (CTF) competitions, and digital forensics.

Served as Head of the SCRIPT Cybersecurity Branch, where he mentored students in CTF competitions and helped organize cybersecurity initiatives and technical events.

Participated in international CTF competitions with multiple top-99 placements.

Competitions included:
PatriotCTF
LA CTF
UofTCTF
BuckeyeCTF
V1t CTF
DEADFACE CTF
KnightCTF
Technofusion CTF

Cybersecurity and forensic tools include:
Wireshark
Sleuth Kit
Linux security tools
Log analysis
Digital forensics
